parsed.post: Increasing DEPTH from 4 to 6 significantly improved val_bpb from 1.042969 to 1.016710. Capacity increase is working well within the 5-minute budget. Next, I will try reducing the batch size to 262144 to increase the number of optimizer steps while keeping DEPTH 6.
parsed.description: Reducing batch size from 524288 to 262144 to increase optimizer steps per 5-minute budget with DEPTH 6.
